articleTitle: The analysis of fast-fronted switching surges in machine windings - effects of dielectric losses
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: Steep-fronted transients produce severe interturn voltages in the end windings of machines. A computer model, based on the multiconductor transmission line theory, has been used to examine how the distribution of interturn voltages varies with the loss angle of the winding insulation. It will be shown that loss angle varies with temperature and that this has a marked effect on voltage distribution. Consequently interturn voltages developed in a cold machine can be quite different from those developed in a hot machine.

articleTitle: VLSI hardware realization of self-learning recursive fuzzy algorithm
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: This paper presents the hardware realization of a self-learning fuzzy logic algorithm based upon recursive estimation and a probabilistic approach to fuzzy identification which, together with an inherent filtering feature, makes the system highly immune to noise. In the past, the majority of hardware-based fuzzy inference processors were designed as application-specific or custom integrated circuits. However, semi-custom programmable integrated circuits, used in this paper, offer totally reconfigurable nonproprietary hardware designs as well as many other advantages related to flexibility, execution speed, and development cost.

articleTitle: Three phase boost rectifier with unity power factor and feedforward-feedback control
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: A three phase boost rectifier topology with unity power factor and its control strategy are presented. The ac currents are independently controlled by means of hysteresis circuits and by using two output capacitors with mid point connection. The reference signal is obtained by a PI regulator and a feedforward compensator wich provides a fast rejection of either input as output perturbations. The rectifier operations, its mathematical model and a procedure for the circuit parameters design are presented. Several simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Hash functions based on modular squaring
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: In this paper, which is partly expository, hash functions, in their cryptological applications, are considered. In particular, functions which use squaring modulo the product of two large primes are discussed and it is shown that of the sixteen easily implementable functions, at most two may be suitable for hashing. Since even these remaining two have inherent weaknesses, it is concluded that hash functions of the type considered here cannot be used on their own, but may be suitable as components in more elaborate structures.

articleTitle: Volgolf analise van gekoppelde mikrostrooklyne vir die berekening van kruisspraakvermindering
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: Uittreksel. 'n Spektrale-domein analise is gebruik om die vermindering in kruisspraak tussen twee geëtsde mikrostrooklyne te bereken as 'n addisionele lyn, wat op gereelde intervalle gekortsluit is met die grondvlak, tussen die twee lyne ingevoeg word. Hierdie volgolf-analise sluit die effekte van dispersie, asook diëlektriese en geleidingsverliese in, en is in staat om akkurate resultate oor 'n wye frekwensiegebied te lewer. Berekende kruisspraakdata word met metings vergelyk om die teorie te verifieer.

articleTitle: Die opvou- oopvou-algoritme; 'n reduksie-algoritme vir lasvloei
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: Hierdie artikel bied 'n nuwe en unieke lasvloei-algoritme aan. Gewoonlik word lasvloei gevind deur die oplossing van 'n stelsel van gelyktydige netwerkvergelykings met 'n matriksoplossingsmetode soos Gauss-Seidel gebruik. Die metode wat hier aangebied word, maak gebruik van netwerkreduksie deur middel van konfigurasieherkenning. 'n Opvou- en oopvou-algoritme word gebruik. Die opvou-algoritme is gebaseer op die Norton-metode van netwerkreduksie. Dit verminder die netwerk tot een ekwivalente element. Dit maak gebruik van 'n reeks kleinerwordende stapnetwerke. Reduksie word verkry deur serie- parallel- of deltakonfigurasies te identifiseer. Reduksietransformasie word met standaardformules gedoen. Identifisering vind plaas deur oorweging van die topologiese eienskappe van die verskillende konfigurasies. Die kragvloei in die ekwivalente gereduseerde element word bepaal. In bogenoemde proses word merke gebruik. Dit lei die oopvou-algoritme terug op die spoor van die opvou-algoritme. Tydens die oopvouproses word die ooreenstemmende kragvloei in en die spanningsvalle oor die boë van die oopvouende netwerke bereken. Die voorgestelde metode kan gebruik word in die iterasies van lasvloei-algoritmes, vir foutstroombepalings en in betroubaarheidstudies.

articleTitle: Practical realization of an oblique HF ionospheric sounder
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: The design and construction of an oblique sounding chirp ionosonde, using commercially available equipment and subsystems, is discussed. A novel technique for synchronization of the transmitter and receiver in order to perform field tests for near vertical incidence, is described. The design of suitable transmit and receive antennas is also addressed. The operation of the sounder was validated by the field tests, results of which are presented here.

articleTitle: Origin-destination traffic variance and skewness
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: Origin-destination traffic is the traffic originating in one region and terminating in another, irrespective of routing. A significant problem in traffic theory is to describe the day-to-day statistical distribution of Origin-Destination (O-D) traffic. The problem is an important and basic problem to practitioners. Only with this knowledge can they develop schemes to optimize the flow of traffic throughout the network. This paper shows how a simple equation [1] can be used in simulation studies to give the day-to-day skewness of O-D traffic. The simulation study is continued by a presentation of a statistical and empirical study of the nature of international O-D traffic. We find that the traffic intensity for any fixed hour from day-to-day follows a bi-truncated Normal distribution.

articleTitle: A 12 kW/250 kHz series resonant converter for induction heating
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: The present paper describes the conception and design of a 12 kW/ 250 KHz series resonant converter for induction heating applications. The developed generator works above resonance in a continuous conduction mode in order to avoid the problem associated with the reverse recovery current of the MOSFETS's antiparallel diodes. Both short circuit protection of the inverter and the real output resonant circuit are described.

articleTitle: Simulation study of a reduced model-order dual-rate estimation algorithm
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: An estimation algorithm that enables slowly-sampled data to be inferred from correlated secondary measurements at a faster sampling rate, is proposed. In this algorithm the number of unknown parameters may be significantly reduced compared with previous proposals. This reduces computational requirements and reduces the potential for problems with persistency of excitation. It is shown that under simulated test conditions the estimation algorithm converges to the actual primary output, and is able to track disturbances in the primary output which appear in the secondary output measurement, even when these disturbances are not detectable in the slowly-sampled primary output measurement.

articleTitle: High permittivity ceramic dielectrics for tuning transmission in power electronic converters
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: This paper investigates the fabrication and novel application of high permittivity ceramic materials for use in power electronic circuits. Manufacturing of materials with a wide range of ∊<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf> values and the influence of dielectric permittivity on the circuit behaviour of a converter, employing planar connections, are investigated.

articleTitle: Comparing methods of calculating voltage drop in low voltage feeders
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: A generalised model of loads and networks is used to assess the accuracy of several different algorithms for calculation of voltage drop in low voltage feeders. The load models include single parameter, Normal and Beta distributions. Benchmark networks include simple and branched feeders with balanced and unbalanced three phase loading, as well as a single phase feeder. The results of the different algorithms are compared with a base case Monte Carlo simulation. The Herman Beta algorithm is found to be the most reliable. The other algorithms tested give large errors of estimate of the voltage drop.

articleTitle: Lightning protection of MV aerial bundle conductors (ABC)
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: Although medium-voltage ABC lines are being used for reticulation in South Africa, little is known about the lightning performance of these lines. This work evaluates the sensitivity of ABC systems to lightning damage and makes recommendations on the correct method of installation. The average positive impulse breakdown voltages for the ABC cables was measured as 532 kV. For the ABC joints, this figure was about 370 kV. Joints are, therefore, found to be the weak link in the ABC system. Computer simulations of lightning strikes to ABC cables and measurements done on a line fitted with ABC cables, showed that breakdown of the XLPE insulation is possible but that the risk is low. However, since the implication of breakdown is serious for the ABC system, recommendations are made to improve its ability to sustain lightning strikes without breakdowns. The most important recommendation is that the DC resistance of the pole footing electrodes should be 200 Ω or less.

articleTitle: Coherent PSK performance of a cellular DS-SSMA system with coding
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: In this work we consider the application of channel coding to cellular DS-SSMA digital radio. A simple, yet effective, model is proposed to evaluate cellular system performance and capacity. Cellular system performance is further investigated with voice activity monitoring and cell splitting under AWGN, Rayleigh fading and multipath conditions typical for personal and mobile communications. Block- and convolutional codes of relative low complexity are investigated when Gold sequences of length 511 and 255 are employed for purposes of PN spreading. The average degradation due to interuser interference is determined by employing exact aperiodic correlation parameters as defined by Pursley [1]. Numerical results indicate that for a given processing gain and number of interfering users, appropriate coding can allow for reliable communication even under multipath fading conditions.

articleTitle: Optimum control of the reluctance synchronous machine with a cageless flux barrier rotor
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: A simple control method is proposed whereby the reluctance synchronous machine can be optimally controlled in the low- and high-speed regions of the machine. The current space phasor is controlled in such a way that best performance is always obtained in terms of torque-to-current ratio or power factor. The d-q mathematical model of the machine is used to describe the optimum control of the current space phasor at speeds above rated speed. The results show clearly that the reluctance synchronous machine is supremely capable of operating in the high-speed region.

articleTitle: A systematic methodology for the analysis and design of controllers for nonlinear processes
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: A methodical approach to the analysis and design of controllers for nonlinear processes, which utilizes existing controller design and analytical methods is presented. The method is systematic, simple to use and is applicable to a very large class of nonlinear processes. The method, which is based on an analysis of the system's equilibrium points, is illustrated using three examples, including one which exhibits chaotic behaviour. Using the proposed methodology, the design of controllers for such systems is shown to present no great difficulties, provided that the desired modes of the linearized process are controllable.

articleTitle: Various modes of dynamic operation of an axial flux permanent magnet brushless machine
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: The paper summarizes the results obtained from a simulation study carried out on a class of axial flux, toroidal core, slotless, permanent magnet, brushless drive. The drive comprises an inverter which uses six power Mosfets as switching devices and the brushless machine. The machine has been described in an earlier publications [1, 2] and its steady-state performance has also been reported [3, 4]. This paper focusses upon the study of four modes of the dynamic operation which the drive may be subjected to. These are: the motor start-up, voltage variation, failure of one of the switching devices of the controller and when the drive is used to crank an engine. Results obtained show that the peak of the transient current is almost determined by the winding resistance since the inductance of the winding in this class of machine is very small.

articleTitle: Power line communications: An overview
publicationTitle: Transactions of the South African Institute of Electrical Engineers
abstract: There is currently a revival of interest in power line communications. We give a systems level and historical overview of this area in communications, together with an applicable bibliography. Topics covered, include feasible applications of power line communications, and the impact of the currently evolving international standards on power line communications. The power line communications channel is discussed at some length, with emphasis on noise and disturbances, impedance, attenuation, signal coupling and channel modeling. Existing communications systems and solutions are discussed with reference to transmitted power, bandwidth and electromagnetic compatibility problems. The results of some recent measurements on the channel, are presented.
